objective: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

description: <name>, Aurel Goldleaf thinks she's found a way to summon and defeat a ruling member of the Abyssal Council!  Such a task will be dangerous, but you have earned great respect amongst the Cenarion Circle.  We know that if anyone can do it, you can.
May fortune go with you, <name>.  Speak with Aurel when you are ready.
completion: What Huum says is true. I believe I know how to summon a lord of the Abyssal Council! Listen on, and I will explain...
